column1: # Every individuated case confirmed outside the DRC, or treated outside it.
# Hand-authored from data/raw/exports/sources.tsv; one row per case the sources
# describe individually. Counts the sources print without individuating are in
# counts.tsv, and the gap between the two is computed, not hidden.
# THREE THINGS ARE KEPT APART THAT ARE EASY TO MERGE. `class` is the source's own
# category for the case (imported, linked, medically_evacuated, unstated), and
# `classification_verbatim` is its words. `infection_country` is where a source
# SAYS the infection happened -- DRC, unstated, or under_investigation, never
# inferred. `mechanism` is how the case left the DRC as the source states it
# (traveller, medical_evacuation, unstated), and `exposure` whether the source
# describes care work or contact with a case. An export likelihood that wants
# only cases sampling general DRC prevalence filters on all three.
# `class_basis` is `inferred` where the class rests on reading two documents
# together; `notes` says which. Empty cells mean not printed.
